title: Eight Sleep Temperature Intervention Spike
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports, Oura, WHOOP, Dexcom, Levels, LibreView, Eight Sleep, Withings, and Garmin Body Battery feeds via vendor APIs, exports, Home Assistant bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eightsleep:sleep
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(temp_adjustments) as temp_adjustments, avg(room_temp_c) as room_temp_c by sleeper _time
| where temp_adjustments>6
| sort - temp_adjustments
description: Uses Eight Sleep exports telemetry to monitor how often the bed had to correct temperature through the night in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for sleep sessions fighting room conditions or recovery stress, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Eight Sleep exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily chart of temperature adjustments and room temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It compares how often the bed had to correct temperature through the night so you can spot sleep sessions fighting room conditions or recovery stress before it becomes annoying.
